The '''19th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in film and television for 1961, were held on March 5, 1962.<ref>{{cite book|title=Box Office|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3rwpxmjK3UgC|year=1962|pages=3–4}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|author=Thomas O'Neil|title=Movie Awards: The Ultimate, Unofficial Guide to the Oscars, Golden Globes, Critics, Guild & Indie Honors|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=mHeGJfp4QLsC|year=2003|publisher=Perigee Book|isbn=978-0-399-52922-1|page=239}}</ref>

==Winners and nominees==
[[File:Maximilian Schell - 1961-jn.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Maximilian Schell]] won for ''[[Judgment at Nuremberg]]'']]
[[File:Geraldine Page by Roy Schatt circa 1950s.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Geraldine Page]] won for ''[[Summer and Smoke]]'']]
[[File:Rosalind Russell - 1950.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Rosalind Russell]] won for ''[[A Majority of One]]'']]
[[File:George Chakiris Medical Center 1970.JPG|thumb|right|160px|[[George Chakiris]] won for ''[[West Side Story (1961 film)|West Side Story]]'']]
[[File:Rita Moreno 2014.jpg|thumb|right|160px|[[Rita Moreno]] won for ''West Side Story'']]
